name: Ira Wolfson
abstract_title: Fetal Consciousness and Graduated Moral Status: A Bayesian Approach to Abortion Ethics
abstract: Binary approaches to abortion ethics generate intractable conflicts by demanding certainty about fetal moral status despite genuine empirical uncertainty about consciousness onset. Pro-life positions require treating fertilized eggs as persons (necessitating IUD prohibition and miscarriage investigation); pro-choice consistency demands permitting late-term elective abortion as mere contraception.
